# Activity needs type, date & note

`BT-6` · Owner decision

**activity needs type + date + note, time optional; Schedule vs Save**

Type required ("Please select an activity type."), date defaults to today, time optional, Schedule for future dates, Save otherwise, past-date confirm. The note field was empty in RT-60's validation, but type was the error shown

Defined in [[brain/context/mobile-flows-captured|App journeys from screenshots]].
